name: Inclined Leg Press
definition: A compound machine squat pattern on one of two exact forty-five-degree fixtures: the bilateral FFITTECH PL688 sled or one independently locked carriage of the Panatta 1FW090 dual system. The working feet remain fixed to a guided plate while the hips and knees extend. Fixture, laterality, carriage state, setup, range, cadence, and load accounting remain record-specific contract boundaries; other leg-press geometries require separate review. Logged plate mass is never comparable across fixtures or to unknown starting resistance.

exerciseRules.description: The FFITTECH record preserves its bilateral study setup and omits Panatta carriage fields.

The Panatta record disengages the reciprocal footboard coupling, uses one independent platform while the unused carriage remains on its independent safety, and compares equal per-side working-carriage plates with stable backrest and stop settings.
The only admitted unilateral inclined press is the exact Panatta independent-carriage fixture.
An independent working-platform marker identifies the Panatta fixture.
The equal per-side load convention belongs only to the Panatta unilateral fixture.

execution.startingPosition: Sit reclined with your back and pelvis on the PL688 pads, hold the handles, and place both feet at medium plate height, hip-width apart and straight ahead.
execution.movement: Lower the sled continuously for two seconds until the knees reach approximately ninety degrees of flexion.
execution.endpoint: Reach the reviewed depth while keeping both whole feet and the supported pelvis in contact.
execution.returnPhase: Press for two seconds to full knee extension without forcefully hyperextending the knees.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the knees tracking with the feet and do not rotate or lift either foot.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your back and pelvis against the pads and both hands on the handles.
disqualifyingCompensations: Lifting a foot or the pelvis removes the reviewed machine contact.
Bouncing at the bottom or abbreviating the depth changes the reviewed range and cadence.

execution.sideOrDirection: Use equal added plates on both sides, enter that per-working-side value once, complete all repetitions with one working leg, then repeat on the other side with the same setup.
execution.startingPosition: On the Panatta 1FW090 only, disengage the reciprocal footboard coupling, select and retain one backrest position and one working-side safety-stop setting, keep the unused carriage on its independent safety, and place one foot on the working platform.
execution.movement: Release the working-side safety and lower that carriage under control to the depth allowed by the retained stop and a supported pelvis.
execution.endpoint: Reach the retained working-side stop or your controlled supported depth without lifting the pelvis.
execution.returnPhase: Press the working carriage upward until the knee is straight without forcefully locking it, then secure the safety.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the working knee tracking with its foot, the reciprocal coupling disengaged, and the unused carriage on its independent safety.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your back and pelvis against the pads and the non-working leg clear of the active platform.
disqualifyingCompensations: Unlocking both carriages changes the one-leg fixture.
Using unequal plate settings cannot be represented by this one-value history.
Changing the backrest or safety-stop setting breaks comparison with the prior history.
Lifting the pelvis from the pad changes the reviewed supported press.
